result.brief: 提出 Multimodal Flow，用共享 chunk-causal flow backbone 在连续 embedding 空间统一建模语言与视觉，避免视觉量化瓶颈，实现单一生成过程。
result.reason: Fully continuous flow matching over language and vision embeddings in a unified multimodal model; directly supports unified understanding-generation and continuous latent multimodal modeling.
